Four are the user-supplied studies (fxAtDpxypSw, j_4B22Y8z28, ZevYcdI1y8I, ikIRxsE9HhU); three more (_gwh1__XecI, P40g1AEuLlY, CUnkvStC93o) were found or reviewed while studying j_4B22Y8z28's own research folder and are recorded here because docs/source-sweep-2026-09-13.md misidentified two of them. Fan-out event files exist only for the four primary studied videos: docs/evidence/footage-fanout-20260926/<id>.json, one per research folder (the j_4B22Y8z28 file also carries the _gwh1__XecI/P40g1AEuLlY/CUnkvStC93o cross-reference events from that same folder's events.json).

boundaryLabelLegend.final-night: footage of the EU (Centaurus) permanent shutdown itself, night of 28 Feb into 1 Mar 2009. This is final-live evidence, not a 'not a final-live rule' boundary.
boundaryLabelLegend.final-week: recorded after D16.5 went live (17 Feb 2009) but before the shutdown night. Treated as final-live-window evidence for mechanics it shows; not shutdown-sequence evidence.
boundaryLabelLegend.launch-era: recorded on or before the upload date and showing pre-rebuild/retired content (here, the obsolete Concordia Divide Eloh Vale, gamecontext 1398). Not a final-live rule; AGENTS.md forbids using it as an analogue for the rebuilt equivalent.
boundaryLabelLegend.pre-d11: recorded before Deployment 11 (went live 2008-08-15) and showing the pre-rebuild boot camp. Not a final-live rule; AGENTS.md forbids using it as an analogue for the rebuilt boot camp.
boundaryLabelLegend.cinematic-only: no gameplay; an intro/opening cinematic. Not shutdown footage, not a mechanics source.

videos.title: Tabula Rasa - Final Minutes before Closing
videos.eraVerdict: final-night: continuous player-view footage of the last ~165 s of the EU shard (Centaurus) before its permanent shutdown, night of 28 Feb into 1 Mar 2009 (inferred, high confidence for event identity; medium for exact clock time, no in-game clock is visible).
videos.scope: Concordia Divide combat and travel into Foreas Base, the ADMIN MESSAGE countdown from '10' to '1', the forced disconnect dialog, the login screen, and the server-selection list showing all four servers OFFLINE. Cross-references docs/gameplay-footage-study-20260924.md's mission 1449 tracker reading.

videos.title: Tabula Rasa Server Shutdown Event HD
videos.resolution: 1280x720, 30 fps (format 136+251); cropped/zoomed render of a 1680x1050 source (chat tab bar cut off)
videos.eraVerdict: final-night: the EU (Centaurus) shutdown, night of 28 Feb into 1 Mar 2009 (00:00 GMT per the uploader's own description). Real CommanderGrog shutdown footage, correcting docs/source-sweep-2026-09-13.md's earlier grouping of this with P40g1AEuLlY and CUnkvStC93o.
videos.scope: Pre-shutdown gathering/festivities, control-point fighting (Hydro Plant Outpost, Ortho/Torden Incline, Dybukkar Forward Camp/Charon's Crossing), the 'ALERT: PLATEAU IS LOST!' admin broadcast, the Earth Last Stand (Empire Sector, Madison Square Park, 28th Street Station, A.F.S. Outpost E34), the shutdown countdown, and the disconnect. The primary id the user supplied; chat text in the fan-out file is read from the higher-resolution _gwh1__XecI reupload of the same edit.

videos.title: "Tabula Rasa" Server Shutdown Event (2021 reupload in better quality)
videos.eraVerdict: final-night: the same 2009 recording and edit as j_4B22Y8z28, re-encoded by CommanderGrog in 2021 from the original Premiere Pro project at source resolution. Not new footage; a higher-fidelity copy of the same event, offset t(j_4B22Y8z28) = t(_gwh1__XecI) + 1.07 +/- 0.1 s.
videos.scope: Used for all chat reading in the fan-out file because the full 1680x1050 aspect ratio is visible (j_4B22Y8z28's 1280x720 render crops the chat tab bar). No independent content beyond j_4B22Y8z28's own edit.

videos.title: Tabula Rasa (Intro)
videos.eraVerdict: not gameplay, not shutdown footage: the game's opening cinematic only (suburban house, Bane invasion of Earth, exodus through the Eloh wormhole, AFS arrival on Foreas, title card "Richard Garriott's Tabula Rasa"). Corrects docs/source-sweep-2026-09-13.md, which listed this as CommanderGrog shutdown footage.
videos.scope: No preservation-relevant events beyond confirming its own content is cinematic, not gameplay; no fan-out file (nothing to trim). Recorded here only to fix the misattribution.

videos.title: Goodbye Tabula Rasa
videos.eraVerdict: final-week, not final-night: recorded 2009-02-20, three days after D16.5 went live and eight days before the shutdown night. A pre-shutdown farewell montage of one English-client character ('Rocky Surpass', roughly levels 4-31). Corrects docs/source-sweep-2026-09-13.md, which listed this as CommanderGrog shutdown footage; the uploader (Greatdictator) is unrelated to CommanderGrog.
videos.scope: Supporting corroboration only: a multiplicative XP-bonus stacking readout (base x group x streak x booster, factor ~=77.28) inside the final live patch window, not shutdown-sequence evidence.

videos.title: Tabula Rasa: End of Eloh Vale
videos.eraVerdict: launch-era: on or before 2007-11-13 (upload), late beta or first days of retail. Not the final night of 2009-02-28 and not final-live content; shows the obsolete, retired Concordia Divide Eloh Vale (gamecontext 1398), replaced in the final client by context 2084.
videos.scope: Squad run through the obsolete Eloh Vale instance (Eloh Bridge, Eloh Shield Gate, Eloh Cave, Eloh Sanctuary), a byte-identical /rave emote match to final playermessagelanguage 976, and a death by chasm fall into obsolete hospital names (gy_eloh_vale, gy_pyramid). AGENTS.md forbids using this obsolete map as an analogue for the rebuilt Eloh Vale.

videos.title: Tabula Rasa: Welcome to Foreas
videos.eraVerdict: pre-D11 live: recording inferred 2008-08-08 to 08-12 from the upload date and the uploader's '4 days of play', three days before Deployment 11 went live (2008-08-15). Shows the pre-rebuild boot camp (Basic Training 101, Obstruction Destruction, A Tale of Elements, The Last Stand in Denzil's Caldera and Luna Cavern), Boargar Acquisition (751) and Predator/Juggernaut targets, all withdrawn or removed by D11.
videos.scope: Player-edited montage across three characters (Luther, boot camp level 1-3; Himo, Concordia Divide level 17-19; Hirlas, Pravus/Crater Lake level 8-11). Confirms the kill-XP base/streak/credit formula and the two-person group bonus display at pre-D11 dates; the boot camp itself must not be used as an analogue for the rebuilt camp (AGENTS.md).
